user.title: Your Nextcloud
user.description: The address of the Nextcloud server the Shopping List app runs on.

data_description.server: For example cloud.example.com. https is used if you leave it out.

auth.title: Grant access in Nextcloud
auth.description: Nextcloud will ask you to grant Home Assistant access. Once you do, this continues by itself.

manual.title: App password
manual.description: Create an app password under Personal settings, Security in Nextcloud.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Nextcloud at that address.
error.invalid_auth: Nextcloud refused the login name or app password.

abort.already_configured: This Nextcloud account is already set up.
abort.login_timeout: Access was not granted in time. Please start again.
abort.missing_app: The Shopping List app is not installed on this Nextcloud.
abort.server_too_old: The Shopping List app on this Nextcloud is too old. Version {version} or later is needed.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Nextcloud account from the one set up here.

data_description.hidden_lists: Ticked lists don't show up in Home Assistant. Lists made later show up by themselves.
data_description.via_label: Shown in the app against items Home Assistant adds or ticks. Leave it empty to show the account's own name.
